scope: Current provenance: 20 user skills plus 3 maintainer skills

classification_rules.native: No identified external source relationship beyond local repository authorship.
classification_rules.reference: External source influenced concepts or workflow, but no upstream file is stored in this repository as part of this classification.
classification_rules.adapted: Upstream file or substantial text is translated, restructured, or modified.
classification_rules.unknown: Evidence is insufficient; do not assume redistribution rights.

skills.name: code-comment
skills.evidence: No external upstream hit identified in current text scan.

skills.name: commit
skills.evidence: The local commit workflow consumes the commit-workflow behavior contract. Official product facts, local policy, and local CLI version observations remain separate; behavior-only source files are not imported or mapped directly to this skill. The cross-product fixture smoke is planned for Phase 7 and has no Phase 1 behavior-result evidence.

skills.name: context-doc
skills.evidence: Context output uses AGENTS.md as the only canonical instruction entry point; the earlier bridge was retired after Claude Code added native AGENTS.md support.

skills.name: create-prototype
skills.evidence: Prototype generation uses local workflow contracts while referencing OpenAI product-design and gstack design-html concepts; no upstream file import is recorded. Phase 4 added the prototype/real-screen boundary and a preceding-input contract that realises only approved motion. UI/UX Pro Max v2.13.0 keeps this abstract input contract unchanged; its dark-mode runtime correction is consumed only through an approved decision. Concepts only.

skills.name: design-doc
skills.evidence: Planning and interview workflow is conceptually similar to Superpowers/gstack planning workflows; local template is not marked as upstream import.

skills.name: design-prototype-docs
skills.evidence: Screen/prototype planning concepts reference OpenAI product-design and gstack design planning only; no upstream file is imported. Phase 4 added a design-system input step and a motion-candidate section. UI/UX Pro Max v2.13.0 keeps the public design-system input contract unchanged; no upstream file, translation or summary is imported.

skills.name: doc-audit
skills.evidence: Document drift verification references the official Codex and Claude context contracts; no external file content is imported.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.evidence: The local production-UI workflow is a translated and substantially restructured derivative of Anthropic Skills frontend-design, with additional harness routing, validation, and platform-neutral rules. OpenAI product-design remains reference-only. Phase 4 added a two-axis preceding-input contract and made motion conditional on an approved motion-design spec. UI/UX Pro Max v2.13.0 continues to supply only approved public design decisions, so no internal upstream path is coupled. Concepts only.

skills.name: git-scoped-account
skills.evidence: Local operational Git-account workflow.

skills.name: harness-bootstrap
skills.evidence: Combines a local scan workflow with the official AGENTS.md context contracts for Codex and Claude Code.

skills.name: harness-setup
skills.evidence: Project context setup follows native AGENTS.md loading for Codex and Claude Code; templates are local and setup blocks preempting Claude instruction files.

skills.name: humanize-korean
skills.evidence: Phase 4 accepted im-not-ai v2.3.0 as an adapted source. Local files preserve concepts, safety contracts, MIT notice, and deterministic guard behavior without vendoring upstream runtime scripts.

skills.name: impl-doc
skills.evidence: Implementation planning resembles external plan/execution workflows, but file content is local.

skills.name: impl-fe-be-doc
skills.evidence: FE/BE phase planning and review gates are reference-only.

skills.name: impl-reuse-scan
skills.evidence: The local discovery-and-approval workflow is original; only existing-pattern and search-before-building concepts are limited references.

skills.name: impl-verify
skills.evidence: Fresh-evidence verification references Superpowers completion discipline and gstack qa-only report semantics without importing auto-fix runtime. Phase 4 added design-token, contrast, focus, touch-target, responsive, state, reduced-motion, motion-purpose, performance and prototype-boundary checks. UI/UX Pro Max v2.13.0 changes dark-mode recommendation coherence only; the existing public decision and verification contract stays file-free. Concepts only.

skills.name: motion-design
skills.evidence: Phase 3 imported the upstream skill tree at commit f9a8a041b85185ee4881b3471d3415e939aac772. director/, patterns/ and reference/ are preserved verbatim; SKILL.md is rewritten for purpose-first classification, optional motion, low-density defaults on public/medical/financial/enterprise screens, mandatory reduced-motion alternatives, evidence-backed layout-triggering properties, approval-gated persistence and public skill handoff. Phase 4 promoted the relationship group to active together with its reference relationship.

skills.name: multi-review
skills.evidence: Multi-perspective review concepts are reference-only.

skills.name: project-write-access
skills.evidence: Local project-document access workflow for signed administrator policy, provider CODEOWNERS generation, Git hooks, and AI write guards. No external skill or runtime file is imported.

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.evidence: Phase 6 applied the approved generated upstream skill tree at v2.13.0 (4d140cf8ff6842de13213c7214eff3810371beb2). data/, references/ and scripts/ are preserved verbatim; SKILL.md remains rewritten for platform-neutral paths, scope confirmation, approval-gated persistence and public skill handoff. v2.13.0 updates dark-mode palette/anti-pattern coherence and adds its upstream regression test. The relationship group remains active together with its reference relationship.

skills.name: custom-skill-design
skills.evidence: The manager-only workflow remains an adapted derivative of Anthropic Skills skill-creator. OpenAI Codex skill-creator and Superpowers are reference-only concept sources with no imported files or internal helper scripts.

skills.name: harness-plugin-maintainer
skills.evidence: Phase 6 implementation. Local deterministic plugin build, validation, manager projection, and release-candidate metadata tooling.

skills.name: skill-portfolio-maintainer
skills.evidence: Phase 5 implementation. Local upstream check, discovery, staging, approval-gated promote, rollback, and eval tooling.
